stages.summary: Play the opening mission and finish Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house — it is the only trophy that can be missed, and it disappears after Chapter 1.
tips: After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and meditate.
Make a manual save at the start and end of the chapter.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — start clean, protect the one missable

stages.summary: Work through Chapters 2, 3 and 4 and their named missions. Take stranger strands as they appear — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone all have final missions here — and hunt Bret's unique animal. Scan vehicles and study animals with the binoculars as you travel: that progress already counts toward the 100% checklist.
tips: Both protagonists are playable from Chapter 2, so side content opens up.
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals for the checklist later.
No mission replay: keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter.
stages.title: Chapters 2–4 — play the story, grab strands as they appear

stages.summary: Complete the final mission for the gold trophy. After the credits the game returns you to free roam, and the 100% completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
tips: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Everything after this stage is open-world cleanup — nothing is locked behind the story.
stages.title: The finale — finish the story

stages.summary: Work the checklist the story unlocked. It is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion — but a few categories demand everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. You need 70 of 80 challenges, so skip the hardest ones.
tips: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges and win a drone race at all 14 locations.
Complete 250 stunts (300 for the checklist) and 50 challenges (70 for the checklist).
Discover 100 vehicles (200 for the checklist) and explore all 52 areas of Leonida.
stages.title: The 100% checklist — the long grind

stages.summary: Finish the remaining stranger strands, the robbery trophies and the money trophies. Most of these overlap with the checklist grind, so many will already be close to done by now.
tips: Finish 8 stranger strands in total for Strangers & Freaks.
Rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck and one illegal operation per gang — then launder $250,000 of marked bills.
Buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
stages.title: Strangers, robberies and money

stages.summary: Sweep up the remaining hidden trophies — the airport departure, the Rhino tank, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom smash, bowling, and the ones whose exact triggers the published guides have not pinned down yet. When the last one pops, the platinum follows.
tips: Several of these have unconfirmed triggers — check the cited PowerPyx guide for the latest findings before grinding one.
Actions Speak Louder (500 Criminal Profile actions) usually pops on its own during normal play.
The platinum pops automatically with the 54th trophy.
stages.title: Odd jobs and the platinum

summary: One playthrough, about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10 (PowerPyx). All 55 trophies are offline and single-player; there are no online trophies. There is no mission replay, so keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots plus one autosave). Cheats disable trophies and saving, and only unlock after the story — leave them off for the whole run.
title: Roadmap to the platinum
